sourceNote: Chamber-only working directory compiled from official organization websites. Individual contacts are included only when the organization publishes the person's current role.

organizations.name: Greenwood Archer Capital
organizations.geography: Chicago, with emphasis on historically underinvested South and West Side communities
organizations.bestFor: Flexible small-business financing, financial coaching, technical assistance, and growth planning
organizations.chamberNextStep: Ask about a chamber referral path, preferred pre-intake information, and a quarterly office-hours partnership for South Side entrepreneurs.

organizations.name: Allies for Community Business
organizations.organizationType: Nonprofit lender and business support organization
organizations.geography: Chicagoland and nearby communities, with priority for underserved entrepreneurs
organizations.bestFor: Small-business loans, grants when available, one-on-one coaching, and business connections
organizations.chamberNextStep: Confirm the cleanest referral path for owners who need both coaching and capital, and ask whether the chamber can host recurring coaching sessions.

organizations.name: SomerCor

organizations.name: Chicago Community Loan Fund

organizations.name: Community Investment Corporation
